source: Martins et al. APS Open Science 1, 000086 (2026), DOI 10.1103/2tp5-1qx4; software and processed work Zenodo 19705797.
exposure: Before scoring, only NPY/pickle grammar, opaque W byte counts and hashes, condition keys and the five scalar calibration fields were read. The physically shared paper/abstract reported aggregate trends and the notebook was inspected as code, excluding its stored output cells. No W floating-point values were decoded before this freeze.
endpoint: All 36 published distributions of work in joules, transformed to W/(1.38e-23*300) for numerics. Eq.10 uses +.5 times sum of realized stiffness increments times x_j squared; no extension to recovered raw trajectories. Authors reconstruct realized stiffness from the PD at 100 kHz; optimal endpoint jumps are smoothed. Each condition stores two stiffness endpoints and uncertainties only plus tau_p, not a waveform or per-cycle calibration. tau_p=.1*1.5e-6 at label .1, not SI tauR times .1. It is preserved verbatim, excluded from computations. Theoretical full-waveform tail forecast is not identified. The original authentic notebook supplies nominal mean-work curves, which cannot uniquely specify a tail; do not compare this shape screen to an author mean as if predicting the same endpoint.
condition_roster: Both linear/optimal protocols, each 18 conditions and 10,000 works per condition. Nominal amplitude 10 has durations .1,.145,.211,.308,.447,.65,.946,1.375,2.0; nominal .145 has amplitudes 1 through 10; count their intersection once. Preserve all 360,000 finite values and every original condition. Refuse missing, duplicate W digest or nonfinite data without filtering.
hypothesis: For a common deterministic quadratic functional of a zero-mean joint Gaussian trajectory, eigenvalues may have either sign. Necessary population constraints L=(k2*k4−1.5*k3^2)/k2^3 >=0 and U=12−k4/k2^2 >=0. Translation of already computed work and positive shared rescaling preserve these margins. Nonzero trajectory means, random realized waveforms/gains, variable cycle histories or non-Gaussian motion may break the premises. Passing does not identify a waveform, confirm the distribution, or rank protocols. Negative finite-sample values do not violate the population law as a matter of algebra.
rights: One complete previously unopened condition census, no fit/tune/train/test split because the signed-eigenvalue constraint uses no learned parameters. No held-out model forecast or predictive accuracy claim. Store-order block grouping replicates author notebook W.reshape(n_blocks,1000). The paper describes 10 independent blocks for its variance uncertainty, but no cycle timestamps, session IDs, per-cycle independent resets, or per-block calibration accompany the arrays. The entire work archive remains one physical source.
inference: For K=10 contiguous 1000-cycle blocks, form means of W^j, j=1..4, in each block; unbiased estimation of raw-moment products under independent common-law blocks uses all ordered distinct assignments of their factors across blocks. No independence within a block is needed for an unbiased product under that conditional model. Compute the numerator estimates and their K-delete-one jackknife standard errors. Scale both by the same complete-condition positive variance powers; ratios themselves need not be unbiased. One-sided margins use t(9) quantile 1−.05/72; a condition/constraint flags if numerator plus critical*SE is strictly negative. The primary family flags if at least one of 72 tests flags. This is a Bonferroni-adjusted approximate screen conditional on sufficient block independence and t calibration. It is not exact familywise inference. Five 2000-cycle and twenty 500-cycle groupings are sensitivity only, never substitutes for primary. Prespecified pooled plug-in cumulants, physical quantiles, extrema, most extreme observed works and neighboring condition/block arithmetic preserve tail influence. No trimming/winsorization or multiple trial splits.
admission: Canonical source freeze precedes all numerical W decoding. The expanded metadata reader must accept the six-field schema and all36 original conditions; the first five-field refusal is preserved. Zero variance or nonfinite data fail admission for the whole census, no selective drop. Source and synthetic controls must pass at native scoring. Publish scientific negatives and sampling limits.
